summary: Tested Site Menus footer backend + frontend integration. Backend footer contract/migration/validation behaviors passed in targeted pytest; UI showed inconsistent footer-card rendering and missing footer data-testid hooks, blocking reliable completion of the full footer configure flow automation.

minor.issue: Existing test_site_menus_support.py assertion expected 503 after restoring contact_form, but environment snapshot had contact_form disabled, so route remained 403. This is test-fixture/state-assumption noise, not a footer API contract failure.
site_menus singleton tests are stateful; parallel xdist run produced cross-test interference. Serial run (-n 1) is stable.

ui_bugs.issue: Footer card not reliably detectable via required data-testid selectors on the public app build; in repeated runs footer controls were absent or rendered without footer testids, preventing robust automation for configure/add/edit/delete/save verification.

integration_issues.flow: UI Site Menus footer rendering vs backend payload
integration_issues.issue: GET /api/site-menus returns footer payload correctly, but UI did not consistently expose a matching configurable Footer block with stable testids in the tested public build.

action_items: Ensure public frontend build renders exactly one Footer card with stable footer data-testid attributes (footer-menu-card, footer-configure-button, etc.) in Site Menus.
Re-run UI flow after footer selectors/rendering are stable to validate toggle/add/edit/delete/custom text save persistence end-to-end.
Keep site_menus singleton regression tests serial or isolate DB state per test to avoid xdist cross-test contamination.
If contact-form regression test remains in suite, harden fixture setup to explicitly re-enable contact_form before asserting missing-key 503 behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend implementation satisfies requested footer API contract: GET exposes footer.enabled/footer.links/footer.custom_text; PATCH persists enabled/page+url links/custom_text; and validations for unknown page, missing URL, duplicate footer IDs, and empty payload are enforced.
Legacy migration path in _get_site_menus adds missing footer while preserving existing faq_items/contact_form data.
Frontend testability gap exists on public build: required footer controls were not consistently discoverable via data-testid despite backend data being present.

success_rate.backend: 92% overall suite run (11/12); 100% for new footer-focused tests (4/4)
success_rate.frontend: 40% (navigation/login/basic Site Menus load passed; required footer configure flow blocked by selector/render inconsistency)

test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used qa@prettycheap.com.au / QaTest123! for admin UI login.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. Snapshot/restore artifacts created under /app/test_reports for site_menus singleton state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_site_menus_footer_cleanup.py as focused regression for this story. Run site_menus tests serially. Confirm footer UI on the public URL exposes stable footer testids before attempting deeper Playwright add/edit/delete checks.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (UI inconsistency): public Site Menus view did not consistently expose footer controls through expected data-testid hooks, while backend /api/site-menus already returned footer data. This caused automation to fail at selector level rather than business logic level. RCA-2 (backend suite noise): singleton site_menus mutation tests can race under xdist; serial execution removes false failures.
